step_description: Nucleophile lone pair attacks the electrophilic carbon from the rear while carbon-leaving group bond breaks simultaneously through a pentacoordinate transition state.
charge_changes: Nu loses negative charge; LG gains negative charge

step_description: Carbon-halogen bond undergoes rate-limiting heterolytic dissociation assisted by polar protic solvent, forming a planar sp2 carbocation and halide anion.
charge_changes: Carbon gains +1 charge; LG gains -1 charge

step_description: Weak nucleophile attacks the planar carbocation with equal probability from either the top or bottom face, leading to substitution with racemization.
charge_changes: Nucleophile gains positive charge / carbon neutralized

step_description: Strong base abstracts the beta-proton while the C-H bond pair collapses to form the C=C pi bond and the leaving group is expelled simultaneously.
bond_changes: B-H formed; C-H broken; C=C pi formed; C-LG broken
charge_changes: Base neutralized; leaving group carries negative charge

step_description: Rate-determining heterolysis of leaving group yields a planar tertiary or resonance-stabilized carbocation intermediate.
Weak base or solvent removes a beta-proton; electrons cascade into the vacant p-orbital of the carbocation to form the most substituted (Zaitsev) alkene.
bond_changes: C-H broken; C=C formed; Base-H formed

step_description: Base removes acidic alpha-proton adjacent to electron-withdrawing carbonyl group to generate a resonance-stabilized carbanion.
Carbanion lone pair electrons push inward to generate the conjugated C=C pi bond, expelling the beta-leaving group (e.g. OH-).
Hydroxide base deprotonates the alpha-carbon of aldehyde or ketone, forming a nucleophilic enolate in equilibrium.
charge_changes: Enolate acquires negative charge on oxygen/alpha-carbon

step_description: Enolate alpha-carbon attacks the electrophilic carbonyl carbon of a second aldehyde molecule to form a beta-alkoxy intermediate.
bond_changes: C-C formed; C=O pi bond broken to C-O-
charge_changes: Negative charge resides on acceptor oxygen

step_description: Alkoxide oxygen abstracts a proton from solvent water, regenerating catalytic hydroxide and yielding the stable aldol addition product.
Base generates enolate which attacks carbonyl partner to produce beta-hydroxy aldehyde intermediate.
Base abstracts remaining alpha-proton and eliminates hydroxide via E1cB pathway yielding thermodynamically favored (E)-enone.
Alkoxide base removes alpha-proton from ester to generate ester enolate.
Enolate attacks second ester carbonyl; tetrahedral intermediate collapses expelling alkoxide leaving group to form beta-keto ester.
Alkoxide base deprotonates doubly activated methylene between the two carbonyls; acidification during workup gives neutral beta-keto ester.
charge_changes: Delocalized enolate stabilized; neutral on acid quench

step_description: The polarized nucleophilic alkyl group of the Grignard reagent (R-MgX) attacks the electropositive carbonyl carbon, displacing pi electrons onto oxygen.
bond_changes: C-C formed; C=O pi broken to C-O-MgX+
charge_changes: Carbonyl carbon sp2 -> sp3; oxygen coordinated to Mg2+

step_description: Addition of aqueous ammonium chloride protonates the magnesium alkoxide, yielding the pure alcohol product and basic magnesium salt precipitate.
Strong acid protonates the carbonyl oxygen of carboxylic acid, significantly increasing the electrophilicity of the carbonyl carbon.
Alcohol oxygen lone pair attacks the activated carbonyl carbon, forming a tetrahedral gem-diol mono-oxonium intermediate.
bond_changes: C-O(alcohol) formed; C=O pi becomes C-OH

step_description: Intramolecular or solvent-mediated proton transfer converts a hydroxyl into good leaving group -OH2+, which is eliminated with reformation of carbonyl C=O.
bond_changes: C-OH2 broken (water departs); C=O reformed; final deprotonation
charge_changes: Neutral ester product + regenerated H+ catalyst

step_description: Sulfuric acid protonates nitric acid, triggering dehydration to generate the potent linear electrophile nitronium ion (O=N+=O).
Aromatic pi cloud attacks the nitronium ion, disrupting aromaticity and creating a resonance-stabilized cyclohexadienyl carbocation (sigma complex).
bond_changes: C-N formed; aromatic pi bond broken

step_description: Bisulfate base (HSO4-) removes the proton from the sp3 carbon; C-H bonding pair restores the aromatic sextet, yielding nitrobenzene.
A 6-pi-electron cyclic transition state occurs simultaneously: diene HOMO interacts with dienophile LUMO to form two new C-C sigma bonds and one new C=C pi bond.
bond_changes: 2 new C-C sigma bonds formed; diene C2-C3 pi bond formed; 2 diene pi and 1 dienophile pi broken

step_description: Hydroxide attacks the carbonyl carbon of non-enolizable aldehyde to form a tetrahedral dianion / monoanion adduct.
Collapse of the tetrahedral oxyanion drives hydride transfer directly to the carbonyl carbon of a second aldehyde molecule.
bond_changes: C=O reformed; C-H formed on second aldehyde
charge_changes: Forms carboxylate salt + alkoxide (rapid proton transfer to alcohol)

step_description: Nucleophilic carbanion of phosphonium ylide attacks carbonyl carbon with simultaneous or rapid P-O bond formation yielding 4-membered oxaphosphetane ring.
bond_changes: C-C formed; P-O formed; C=O pi and P=C broken

step_description: The strained 4-membered oxaphosphetane ring collapses spontaneously driven by the extraordinary thermodynamic strength of the P=O bond (575 kJ/mol), liberating the alkene.
bond_changes: C=C pi bond formed; P=O double bond formed; C-O and C-P broken

step_description: Peroxyacid oxygen adds nucleophilically to ketone carbonyl to form tetrahedral Criegee intermediate.
More substituted alkyl/aryl group migrates with retention of configuration onto adjacent peroxy oxygen with simultaneous cleavage of weak O-O bond and expulsion of carboxylate.
bond_changes: C-C broken; C-O formed; O-O broken; C=O reformed
charge_changes: Ester or lactone product + carboxylate byproduct

step_description: Acid activates oxime OH into good leaving group (-OH2+ or -OTs); the group positioned anti to OH undergoes stereospecific 1,2-migration to nitrogen with water expulsion, forming a nitrilium ion.
bond_changes: C-C broken; C-N formed; N-OH broken

step_description: Water traps the electrophilic nitrilium carbon to form an imidate intermediate which tautomerizes to the stable secondary amide.
bond_changes: C-OH formed; tautomerizes to C=O and N-H

step_description: Borohydride B-H bond electrons attack carbonyl carbon; pi electrons move onto oxygen to form borate alkoxide complex.
bond_changes: C-H formed; C=O pi broken to C-O-
charge_changes: Alkoxide oxygen carries negative charge coordinated to sodium

step_description: Protic solvent (MeOH/EtOH) protonates alkoxide to furnish alcohol product and regenerate borate ester.

step_title: Concerted Butterfly Transition State Oxygen Transfer
step_description: Electrophilic terminal peroxy oxygen is transferred to the alkene pi bond while peroxy proton transfers internally to peroxy carbonyl in a concerted butterfly transition state.
bond_changes: Two C-O sigma bonds formed; C=C pi broken; O-O broken; mCBA formed
